title: The Economics of Matching: Stability and Incentives
source_inventory_policy: Source basis: documented source inventory for Roth 1982 from prior source audit and validation report; local source text not tracked in this repo. Curated by the 2026-06-28 source-grounded coverage pass. Dashboard-seeded keys were checked against the source inventory reports/source text when available; explicitly missing named source items are recorded as out_of_scope rather than silently omitted.

theorem1_stable_complete_outcome_exists_.statement:
-
Theorem 1: on an equal-size strict marriage domain, a stable complete outcome
exists.
theorem1_stable_complete_outcome_exists_.source_location: paper-facing review target; exact source location to be refined

theorem2_optimal_stable_outcomes_on_stri.statement: - Theorem 2: men-optimal and women-optimal stable outcomes exist on the strict marriage domain.
theorem2_optimal_stable_outcomes_on_stri.source_location: paper-facing review target; exact source location to be refined

theorem3_no_stable_truthful_procedure_on.statement:
-
Theorem 3: on Roth's strict 3-by-3 counterexample domain, no procedure stable
on strict profiles is truthful for both sides.
theorem3_no_stable_truthful_procedure_on.source_location: paper-facing review target; exact source location to be refined

theorem4_serial_dictatorship_constructed.statement:
-
Theorem 4: Roth's constructed serial-dictatorship procedure is efficient on
strict men-side profiles, truthful for men on that strict men-side domain, and
truthful for women.
theorem4_serial_dictatorship_constructed.source_location: paper-facing review target; exact source location to be refined

theorem5_optimal_side_truthful_on_strict.statement:
-
Theorem 5: side-optimal deferred-acceptance procedures are strategyproof on
equal-size strict marriage domains.

corollary5_1_no_need_to_misrepresent_fir.statement:
-
Corollary 5.1: under each side-optimal DA procedure, the non-proposing side can
match any report's outcome with a report preserving its true first choice.
corollary5_1_no_need_to_misrepresent_fir.source_location: paper-facing review target; exact source location to be refined

lemma1_strict_simple_misrepresentation_s.statement: - Lemma 1: Roth's strict simple-misrepresentation same-partner route.
lemma1_strict_simple_misrepresentation_s.source_location: paper-facing review target; exact source location to be refined

lemma2_strict_simple_misrepresentation_n.statement: - Lemma 2: a strict simple misrepresentation cannot harm any other man on the strict marriage domain.
lemma2_strict_simple_misrepresentation_n.source_location: paper-facing review target; exact source location to be refined

theorem6_weak_pareto_for_men_on_strict_m.statement: - Theorem 6: the men-optimal stable outcome is weakly Pareto optimal on the strict marriage domain.
theorem6_weak_pareto_for_men_on_strict_m.source_location: paper-facing review target; exact source location to be refined

theorem7_arbitrary_k_on_strict_profiles.statement:
-
Theorem 7: for any `k > 1`, some finite balanced strict-profile market admits a
profitable stable-procedure `k`th-choice manipulation.

assumption_equal_cardinality.statement:
-
The source marriage-problem representation uses balanced one-to-one markets.
This is the equal-size condition needed for complete strict-marriage endpoints.
